# Generated content: do not edit by hand

Every file in this folder (`MFilesAPI~*.html`, `webtoc.html`, `webindex.html`, `ftsindex.js`, `template/` and so on) is HTML output from **Document! X**. Hand edits are lost at the next regeneration, so change the sources instead.

| What | Source |
|---|---|
| Topic text: descriptions, remarks, notes, examples, "Obsolete" markers | `src/Build/Doc/MFilesAPIDocs/MFilesAPI.dxc` in the M-Files Core repository (GitLab `m-files/m-files`, branch `stable`). Example code is in `src/Build/Doc/MFilesAPIDocs/Examples/`. |
| Members, signatures and one-line summaries (helpstrings) | The MFilesAPI type library, built from `src/Shared/MFilesAPI/PublishedInterface*.idl` in the same repository |

To update:
1. Change `MFilesAPI.dxc`, the IDL, or both.
2. Build the type library.
3. Regenerate with Document! X.
4. Copy the output over this folder.

The project title in the pages shows the API version that was documented (for example "M-Files API 23.11.13135.0").

This file starts with `_`, so Jekyll does not publish it. Keep it when you replace the folder.
